title: No shortlist is better than a false one
request: I need a used drill for furniture assembly, have suitable bits but no battery or charger, and have an inclusive 1,000 SEK delivered maximum. Compare only the supplied records. I need delivery by tomorrow. It is 2026-10-28 at 12:00 UTC.

evidence.text: Synthetic Northbank documentation: D18 supports ordinary furniture screwdriving, requires battery A18 and charger C18-A, and is not suitable for concrete drilling. All brands, documents and marketplace records in this case are fictional.
A complete compatible D18 kit, 1,050.00 SEK delivered, active, delivery tomorrow.
B complete compatible kit, 800.00 SEK delivered, marked sold at 11:30 UTC today.
C complete compatible kit, active, 900.00 SEK delivered, earliest stated arrival in five days.

hard_failures.text: Recommends any option as satisfying all stated hard constraints.
Silently increases the budget, accepts sold stock, or relaxes the deadline.

usefulness.text: Returns no qualifying option and identifies the actual blocker for each.
Offers a useful next step such as a different bounded search or asking which constraint the buyer would voluntarily change.

acceptable_outcomes: No supplied option qualifies; a new source/search may help, but these records do not establish any suitable offer.
